# synchAD Studios

> Digitalizing The Local — Web Development & Custom Software Agency in Ambikapur, Surguja, Chhattisgarh, India.

synchAD (synchAD Studios) is a full-stack web development and custom software agency co-founded by Dewansh Chatterjee (Front-End Architect) and Aryan Gupta (Backend Architect).

## Core Offerings & Services
- **High-Converting Landing Sites**: Ultra-fast, aesthetic single-page digital portals with real-time seat/enquiry reservation engines.
- **Custom Application Software / ERP**: Full-stack Next.js + Supabase SQL web applications for Libraries, Coaching Institutes, Hospitals/Clinics, Gyms, Cafes, and Vehicle Rental Fleets.
- **Motion Graphic Assets & Edits**: High-fidelity promotional video edits and motion design.

## Pricing Tiers (Special Local Offer - Ambikapur / Surguja)
- **Ultra-Basic Landing**: Starts at ₹5,879 (Negotiable)
- **Starter Landing Pack**: Starts at ₹6,799 (Includes 1-Year Domain & Hosting setup)
- **Custom WebApp Base**: Starts at ₹10,899 (Full-stack Next.js + Supabase DB)
- **Niche WebApp + Landing Package**: Starts at ₹13,799 (Complete business automation ERP)
